turns.text: Give me a campfire story for kids. Spooky but not nightmare spooky.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How about the lantern in the woods? A girl sees a light bobbing between the trees every night, and nobody believes her.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: One night she follows it and finds an old man looking for his lost dog. He's been searching for years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's the twist. She helps him look, and at sunrise they find the dog, and both of them just fade away, happy. The light never comes back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to question it. I still think it's right, though you know your situation best.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Aw. That's spooky and sweet. My youngest will cry.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then end it with the girl getting a puppy of her own. Happy tears only.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect. Do you have a funny one too,

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: for when they're too wired to sleep?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try the bear who borrowed a tent. He keeps zipping himself in upside down. Kids love doing the voices.
